# szimnau.dk

> Real-world Home Assistant guides, hardware reviews, and automation blueprints by Rolf Szimnau — an IT advisor and home automation enthusiast based in Denmark. All content is based on personal, hands-on experience with actual hardware running in a live smart home setup.

Rolf Szimnau writes in-depth technical guides covering Home Assistant integrations, automation blueprints, dashboard design, and hardware reviews. The site is multilingual (English, Danish, German). Content is practical and specific — configurations, YAML, CSS, and real outcomes rather than theory.

## Blog

- [Teaching a Miele Washing Machine to Wait for Cheap Electricity](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/miele-washing-machine-home-assistant/): Our washing machine died, so I bought a Miele for its native Home Assistant integration, then found it has no delayed-start register like the dishwasher.
- [Four Independent DMI Weather Alerts in Home Assistant](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/dmi-weather-alerts-home-assistant/): The built-in MeteoAlarm integration shows one alert at a time. cap_alerts creates one entity per DMI alert: storm, cloudburst, snow and heat, independently.
- [A Detections-Only Event List for Home Assistant Cameras](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/detection-event-log-home-assistant/): The logbook card shows both Detected and Cleared for camera sensors. The fix: an input_text rolling log, an automation with trigger IDs, and a markdown card.
- [Bathroom Fan Monitoring in Home Assistant: XIAO ESP32-C3 Bluetooth Proxy + Fresh Intellivent Sky](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/fresh-intellivent-sky-ble-proxy-home-assistant/): Setting up a XIAO ESP32-C3 as a Home Assistant Bluetooth proxy, adding Fresh Intellivent Sky fans over BLE, and a crash that looked like bad range but wasn't.
- [Google Find My in Home Assistant: Track Devices on a Dark Dashboard](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/google-find-my-home-assistant/): Full FMDN setup for Home Assistant: fix the unavailable state, dark-theme the Leaflet map via shadow DOM injection, and know when FMDN isn't the right tool.
- [eTilbudsavis in Home Assistant: Sorted by Store, with Proximity Alerts](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/etilbudsavis-shopping-list/): How I connected eTilbudsavis to Home Assistant, sorted the list by store with price in the description, and added proximity push notifications for each store.
- [Home Assistant Recorder: Cut Database Growth from 160 MB/day to Under 50 MB](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/ha-recorder-database-optimization/): My HA SQLite database hit 963 MB in six days. The exact recorder config that cut daily growth by over 70%: full YAML and the reasoning.
- [A Spoken Morning Briefing in Home Assistant: Calendar, Weather, and Electricity Price](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/ha-morning-briefing-tts/): A daily 06:00 spoken briefing in Home Assistant: Google AI TTS, three family calendars, EV charge status, Waze traffic, power price and waste day.
- [A Home Assistant Blueprint That Stops the Heat When a Window Opens](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/window-heating-automation/): The radiator turns off when the window opens and back on when it closes, built as a reusable Blueprint so the next room takes 30 seconds.
- [Nightly Home Assistant Health Checks with GitHub Actions](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/ha-nightly-health-check/): A nightly CI pipeline runs 22 tests against my live Home Assistant setup and opens a GitHub issue when something breaks, before I notice.
- [Škoda Elroq and Home Assistant, Six Months Later](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/skoda-elroq-home-assistant/): What the MyŠkoda integration actually gives you in HA, what's missing, and a useful EV dashboard with battery progress and pre-conditioning.
- [MailBoxGuard: LoRa Mailbox Sensor 200 Metres from the House](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/mailboxguard-lora-home-assistant/): A PricelessToolkit MailBoxGuard wired to an AliExpress LoRa gateway: instant push when mail arrives, no battery change in over a year.
- [Running Sonos and Google Nest Speakers as One System in Home Assistant](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/sonos-google-nest-home-assistant/): Unifying a Sonos speaker with four Google Nest Audio speakers via Home Assistant scripts. No third-party bridges, no subscription.
- [WiZ Circadian Lighting That Tracks the Sun's Color Temperature](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/wiz-circadian-lighting/): Circadian lighting with WiZ bulbs and the HA sun entity: no third-party integration, one automation maps solar elevation to colour temperature.
- [Govee and LEDVANCE Outdoor Lights on a Sunset Schedule in Home Assistant](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/outdoor-lights-sunset-schedule/): No more adjusting the outdoor light timer twice a year. One HA automation turns Govee and LEDVANCE string lights on at sunset, off at midnight.
- [WiZ Lights That React to the TV Without a Cinema Mode Button](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/wiz-movie-lights/): The living room lights dim when a movie starts, brighten on pause and restore when the TV turns off. No scene button, no voice command.
- [Pausing the TV Automatically for Regular Calls and Messenger](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/tv-pause-phone-calls/): One automation pauses the TV the moment either phone rings. Regular calls resume automatically, Messenger video calls get a notification button.
- [License Plate Reading and TV Snapshots From a Reolink CX810](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/sentinel-reolink-alpr-tv/): How I got a Reolink CX810 4K PoE camera to read license plates with AI and push a snapshot straight to the TV when someone pulls into the driveway.
- [Scheduling a Bosch Dishwasher in Home Assistant by Electricity Price](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/ha-appliances-dashboard/): Bosch dishwasher via Home Connect: a dashboard with programme selection and finish-time control, plus a button that finds the cheapest hour to run.
- [One Home Assistant Screen for Four People's Calendars](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/ha-calendar-view/): How I combined four Google Calendars plus waste collection into a single colour-coded HA view that replaced the wall calendar we'd had for years.
- [The Home Assistant Home Screen That Only Shows What Matters](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/ha-context-aware-home-screen/): An HA home screen where every card earns its place: conditional cards, a priority alert ticker, and a Škoda section that follows the charger state.
- [How I Charge the Car on Cheap Danish Spot Prices](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/danish-electricity-prices-ev-charging/): Energi Data Service in Home Assistant: track hourly spot prices, find the cheapest charging window, and automate Škoda Elroq charging hands-free.
- [What's Actually Useful About the Roborock Map in Home Assistant](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/roborock-interactive-map-ha/): Roborock S5 Max in Home Assistant: interactive map card, room-segment cleaning, and the maintenance tracking that saves your brushes.
- [A Tado Heating Dashboard With card_mod That's Actually Worth Looking At](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/tado-home-assistant-dashboard/): 5 Tado zones in Home Assistant with mushroom climate cards, a CSS breathing animation for active heating, and presence setback that works.
- [Camera Notifications That Actually Tell You Something](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/sentinel-ai-camera-ha/): How I got the Sentinel camera to send useful, actionable alerts instead of 40 motion pings a day: one automation, a mute toggle, and action buttons.
- [Mammotion Flora in Home Assistant: The Parts That Actually Work](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/mammotion-flora-ha-integration/): Mammotion Flora (Luba Mini 2) in Home Assistant: GPS boundary mowing, weather-aware scheduling, and the satellite count quirk nobody warns you about.
- [The Glassmorphism CSS Behind All My Home Assistant Dashboards](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/ha-glassmorphism-dashboard-design/): The six CSS constants I use on every card across three HA dashboards, plus patterns for progress bars, map cards and the ::before overlay.
- [The Right Way to Run Home Assistant on Proxmox](https://szimnau.dk/en/blog/proxmox-home-assistant-setup/): Moving Home Assistant from Raspberry Pi 4 to a Dell OptiPlex 7060 on Proxmox VE: VM sizing, USB passthrough, and why snapshots changed how I handle updates.
